integrity-due-diligence.title: Integrity Due Diligence
integrity-due-diligence.short: Pre-transaction and pre-hire integrity checks across CEE, Russia-CIS, and global jurisdictions.
integrity-due-diligence.lead: Pre-transaction and pre-hire integrity checks on individuals and entities across CEE, Russia-CIS, and global jurisdictions. Sourcing is multilingual and native-language. Standard subjects turn around in three to five business days; complex subjects on a scoped timeline.
engagements: Pre-acquisition target screening for a mid-market private equity fund
C-suite and board pre-hire checks for a multinational entering the region
Counterparty integrity reviews on commodities and infrastructure deals
Sanctions and beneficial-ownership unwinds across CIS jurisdictions
integrity-due-diligence.scoping: Brief intake, conflict check, source plan, and fixed-fee proposal where scope allows.
integrity-due-diligence.delivery: Native-language open-source research, public-records review, and discreet human enquiry.
integrity-due-diligence.handover: Structured report, source register, and a verbal briefing with the lead analyst.
deliverables: Structured integrity report (red-flag summary plus narrative)
Source register with provenance and date stamps
Executive briefing to deal team or general counsel

geopolitical-risk.title: Geopolitical & Country Risk
geopolitical-risk.short: Market-entry risk, political-cycle analysis, and bespoke country briefings.
geopolitical-risk.lead: Market-entry risk, political-cycle analysis, scenario planning, and bespoke country briefings. Our depth is in CEE and Russia-CIS, with selective MENA-adjacent coverage where it intersects with European interests.
engagements: Country-entry risk briefing for an industrial investor
Election-cycle scenario planning for a foreign affairs team
Standing geopolitical retainer for a multinational executive committee
Sanctions trajectory and second-order effects assessments
geopolitical-risk.scoping: Question definition, decision relevance, and a written brief that fixes scope.
geopolitical-risk.delivery: Primary and secondary research, expert interviews, and structured analysis.
geopolitical-risk.handover: Written briefing, scenarios with indicators, and a working session with decision owners.
deliverables: Scenario set with leading indicators to monitor
Closed-door briefing for the executive or board

cyber-threat-intelligence.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence
cyber-threat-intelligence.short: Threat-actor and campaign tracking, dark-web monitoring, and pre-incident posture assessment.
cyber-threat-intelligence.lead: Threat-actor and campaign tracking, ransomware-group monitoring, dark-web and Russian- and Ukrainian-language source coverage, IOC feeds, and pre-incident posture assessment. We support, but do not replace, your incident-response retainer.
engagements: Standing threat-actor coverage for critical infrastructure operators
Ransomware exposure and victim-disclosure monitoring for a sector
Targeted brand and executive monitoring across closed forums
Pre-incident readiness review and tabletop facilitation
cyber-threat-intelligence.scoping: Asset and adversary mapping, then a tailored collection plan.
cyber-threat-intelligence.delivery: Continuous collection across surface, deep, and dark-web sources, in source-language.
cyber-threat-intelligence.handover: Periodic reporting cadence, IOC delivery, and on-demand analyst access.
deliverables: Threat landscape report and monthly cadence updates
Curated IOCs and TTP narratives for security operations
Direct analyst access for incident triage support

investigations.title: Investigations & Asset Tracing
investigations.short: Sensitive investigations, fraud and corruption matters, and asset tracing in support of disputes.
investigations.lead: Sensitive investigations, fraud and corruption matters, sanctions evasion, and asset tracing in support of disputes and recoveries. Engagements are delivered in coordination with outside counsel and under privilege where appropriate.
engagements: Asset tracing across multiple jurisdictions in support of recovery proceedings
Sanctions-evasion mapping for a Western financial counterparty
Internal investigation support for a regulated multinational
Discreet enquiry into reputational and integrity allegations
investigations.scoping: Counsel-led intake, privilege framework, and a written investigation plan.
investigations.delivery: Open-source, public-records and discreet human-source work to a defined evidentiary standard.
investigations.handover: Findings memorandum, exhibits binder, and witness or counsel briefing.
deliverables: Findings memorandum suitable for use under privilege
Working session with counsel and, where requested, witness preparation

monitorship-compliance.title: Monitorships & Independent Compliance Reviews
monitorship-compliance.short: Court-, regulator-, or board-mandated monitorships and independent reviews.
monitorship-compliance.lead: Court-, regulator-, or board-mandated monitorships and independent reviews, including post-settlement compliance programmes. We are explicit about independence: we will not accept a monitorship where we hold a conflicting commercial interest.
engagements: Independent monitor in a post-settlement compliance programme
Board-commissioned review of a compliance function
Independent review of an internal investigation
Programme assessment against EU and US enforcement expectations
monitorship-compliance.scoping: Mandate definition, independence assessment, and stakeholder protocol.
monitorship-compliance.delivery: Document review, interviews, and field testing under a defined work plan.
monitorship-compliance.handover: Reporting to the appointing authority on the agreed cadence.
deliverables: Independent reports to the court, regulator, or board
Annual or interim certifications as required

advisory-retainer.title: CEO & Board Advisory Retainer
advisory-retainer.short: Always-on senior advisory to a small number of CEO, Chair, and Minister-level clients.
advisory-retainer.lead: Always-on senior advisory to a small number of CEO, Chair, and Minister-level clients on geopolitical, regulatory, and reputational matters. Capacity is deliberately limited; we accept new retainers only where we can sustain a single point of contact at partner level.
engagements: Standing geopolitical advisory to a multinational chief executive
Crisis communications and reputational counsel during a regulatory event
Confidential second-opinion work on sensitive board decisions
Discreet introductions and back-channel facilitation where appropriate
advisory-retainer.scoping: Direct conversation with the principal and a short written engagement letter.
advisory-retainer.delivery: On-call access to a partner, with structured monthly cadence and ad-hoc work.
advisory-retainer.handover: Continuous — no formal handover; periodic relationship review.
deliverables: Direct partner access and discreet counsel
Quarterly written outlook tailored to the principal's portfolio

about.title: Who we are.
about.whoBody1: Elears is a Wrocław-headquartered private intelligence firm. We combine an AI-native platform with a senior services bench drawn from former intelligence, prosecutorial, diplomatic, and investigative-journalism backgrounds. Our analysts work in Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, German and English.
about.whoBody2: We serve three audiences: NATO and EU defence buyers; global law firms and multinationals operating in the region; and Polish and CEE enterprises with cross-border exposure. We are independent of any client, government, or vendor.
about.heritageBody: Elears renders the Polish chorągiew elearska — the period name for the Lisowczycy, the elite 17th-century Polish-Lithuanian light cavalry famed for cross-border reconnaissance, autonomy, and intelligence-gathering for the Crown. They were Polish-led and allied-deployed. The continuity is not aesthetic; it is operational.
about.leadershipNote: Leadership names and biographies are confirmed at the point of mandate.
ethicsBullets: Independent. We do not accept contingent fees on outcomes that create legal exposure.
We do not accept mandates targeting journalists, activists, or whistleblowers.
Aligned with the GDPR and the EU AI Act; data and infrastructure inside the European Union.
Conflicts-of-interest protocol applied at intake and throughout the engagement.
Analyst-in-the-loop on all AI-generated outputs; no unsupervised model output leaves the firm.
